agent_request_anchor._doc: ORPHAN-MEDIUM-492 — how long a minted agent-invocation request stays claimable. target_sha names the commit the request's plan and evidence are grounded at; past this window the request describes a tree the repo has moved off. The nightly cadence is daily and a request is meant to be consumed by the cycle that minted it, so 3 days is already generous. Age is the check that binds on the live lane: it needs no git history, so it works on the depth-1 shallow clone actions/checkout gives both ARIA workflows. Reachability is checked ONLY when an anchor is present AND the clone is not shallow (ORPHAN-CRITICAL-494) — in a partial clone, absence of the object is not evidence the commit is gone.

auto_promote._doc: Plan ARIA-V6 §2e v2 — narrow auto-promotion exception. Default disabled; operator MUST opt-in via override. Even when enabled, the operator_approval path is UNCHANGED — auto-promote is a parallel admission, not a replacement.

change_review._doc: SE-13 (service-expertise PLAN §3.7, §4.3; DECISIONS Q7) — change-review caps (claims into proof, seats per change and per cycle) and seat envelopes, parsed strictly by genesis_policy.change_review_policy: every key required, an unknown or out-of-range key refused by its dotted path, no default fill (an override replaces the block whole). Every cap is a HOLD for its reader, never a raise.

knowledge._doc: PLAN §3.7. Token caps per seat prompt: touched_service_tokens for the touched service's knowledge, impacted_contract_tokens per impacted facing contract, at most impacted_entries_per_seat impacted entries (contract edges first). sections_in_render_order is the one section list: sections render in this order, rows newest first inside a section, and a cap cuts from the END, so anti_patterns are dropped first and missed last; the drop count is rendered. A section ablation (service_expertise.dev_check) and a tombstoned section name sections from this list.

proof._doc: WP-D4 (DESIGN-discovery D4). claims_per_change: how many of ONE change's claims enter proof (judgment_funnel.admit_change_claims). The highest ranked enter - severity, then confidence, then claim_id ascending, so the split never depends on arrival order; every other claim is held, stays a hypothesis, and gets exactly one change_review_budget_held governance row naming it. overflow: what a claim over the cap becomes. The vocabulary has one member, hold, on purpose: every cap is a hold for its reader, never a raise and never a silent drop.

seats._doc: PLAN §4.3 and §3.7(c). A change-review seat is a discovery seat (touched service or lens); hand-off and arbiter seats are judge seats, capped per change here and counted against the WP-J funnel envelope (§3.7(b)), not against seats_per_cycle. Per change: up to service_seats_per_change touched services in closure order (each further service gets a change_review_budget_held row) plus lens_seats_per_change cross-cutting lens; handoff_seats_per_change hand-offs (Q7; excess held by name, the claims stay hypotheses); at most arbiter_seats_per_handoff arbiter per hand-off. seats_per_cycle: change-review seats admit_request admits in one production cycle, two changes at full discovery width (a retirement counterfactual seat counts here); beyond it request_admission_throttled:change_review_envelope. seats_per_dev_look: the DEV build envelope, change-review seats one DEV-check look may mint: at most 50 change subjects x 2 arms x 4 discovery seats. A look whose plan needs more is not started (recorded in RUNS.md), never run partially. WP-D4 (DESIGN-discovery D4): prover_seats_per_change and judge_seats_per_change are the proof-side seats one change may take (the reproduction seat that pins a claim, the judges of the claims admitted to proof); with the discovery and hand-off seats above they bound ONE change at 14 LLM seats (3 service + 1 lens + 2 hand-off + 4 prover + 4 judge). The door (request_admission.admit_request, subject_ref) counts a change's discovery seats from the request ledger and refuses the seat past service_seats_per_change + lens_seats_per_change by name (change_review_seat_cap); the mint counts the seat again under the request ledger's lock (request_admission.require_change_seat), so an admission reused, or many decided before the first mint, cannot take a change past them.

circuit_breaker._doc: ORPHAN-MEDIUM-483 / RC-4 — failure_window_hours is DELIBERATELY ABSENT. It is derived as minimum_window_hours(failure_threshold) = threshold x cadence + cadence, so for threshold 3 on the nightly's 24h cadence the window is 96. This file used to ship the literal 72, which is exactly the boundary the derivation exists to forbid: failures land at t=0/24/48 and the gate reads at t=72, so a 72h window puts the oldest failure on the edge and ±30min of cron jitter flips the verdict. Worse, the loader silently widened 72 to 96, so this file documented a number the code refused to honour and an operator reading it learned the wrong thing about their own breaker. Setting the key here again, or below the floor in an override, is now REFUSED with both numbers named rather than silently corrected.

convergent_authoring._doc: Plan ARIA-V6 §2d v2 — convergent adapter authoring loop config. Operator opt-in via skill-genesis request --convergent.

drift_class_weights._doc: Plan S4 (ORPHAN-MEDIUM-298) - per-drift-class pressure score multipliers. 1.0 = neutral (default behaviour is bit-identical); >1.0 biases cycles toward that class, <1.0 deprioritizes. Applied in pressure.run_pressure AFTER base scoring, re-capped at 100. Override via <repo>/aria-config/genesis_policy.json.

f_finding_loop_guards._doc: ARIA-HIGH-260 / ADR-0003 prerequisites 3-5 — loop guards on the aging F_FINDING plan source, which plans ARIA's own findings unattended. max_plans_per_24h: at most this many F_FINDING-sourced plans may START in any rolling 24h window, counted from plan_started stamps on the plan ledger (a plan an operator request bound never counts; 0 switches the source off; above 24 is REFUSED). cool_off_days: a finding whose earlier plan failed (implementation_rejected, plan_abandoned, plan_evaluated HUMAN_REQUIRED), or after whose merge another finding was emitted on the surfaces it changed, is not re-planned by this source for this many days; a plan the self-revert producer attributed a bad outcome to quarantines its finding until an operator-sourced plan for it starts. Operator requests (priority 0) are never judged by these guards. Read by finding_grounding.f_finding_loop_policy, key by key over this block; a block that is not an object, an unknown key or an out-of-bounds value refuses every F_FINDING candidate by name.

genesis_lifecycle._doc: Enterprise autonomy lifecycle gate. Skill/agent genesis cannot jump from pressure gap to request/draft/materialization without HUMAN_REQUIRED, real sandbox, SHADOW, EVAL_WINDOW and ACTIVE evidence.

implementer_turn_budget._doc: Operator decision 2026-09-16 (120; 2026-09-12 set 60, which the first live implementation spent to the turn before its commit) — budgeted Edit + Write + Bash + MultiEdit + NotebookEdit turns one implementer request may be admitted (cycle_and_turn_budget_cap, policy §14). This was the literal 10 in turn_budget.IMPLEMENTER_TURN_BUDGET; each Edit is one turn and each test run is one Bash turn, so a root-cause implementation spends 20-40 and 10 was a wall. The cap exists to stop a runaway loop (perf CRIT-001 / ai HIGH-013); the run's job deadline is the real budget under the managed-subscription policy. Every reader takes the value from the policy of the workspace the tools store is bound to (turn_budget_policy.implementer_turn_budget_for_store): the executor compiles it into the spawn settings (--turn-budget), the hook admits each turn against it, and pre-merge refuses evidence recorded under any other cap by name. Values below 1 are REFUSED (a cap of zero refuses the first turn: that switches implementers off, it does not budget them); values above 2 x plan_convergence.MAX_AFFECTED_PATHS (400) are REFUSED with both numbers named so a policy cannot switch the cap off; a block that is not an object, or a key other than budgeted_turns (keys starting with _ are annotations), is REFUSED by name so a misspelling never silently runs on this default.

request_admission._doc: ARIA-HIGH-364 (2026-10-07) — agent-request admission (request_admission.admit_request). Critical-path mints (plan steps, implementation and its reviews, operator acts) are always admitted. A discretionary mint is admitted only while the executor drains (no result or claim for executor_liveness_hours while a claimable request has waited as long stops it), the role has a provider that is not cooled, and the claimable backlog stays within budget = max(backlog_floor, backlog_days_of_drain x drained-per-day over drain_window_days). plan_seeds_per_cycle new plans start per cycle ahead of the budget (still requiring a draining executor and an uncooled provider), because panels and judges run earlier in the cycle and would otherwise take all headroom. An out-of-bounds value takes the shipped default and is disclosed once on governance (request_admission_policy_invalid). Measured 2026-10-06: ~28 drained/day against ~66 minted. Bounds: request_drain_capacity.REQUEST_ADMISSION_BOUNDS; a value outside them is refused by name.

rhythm._doc: Wall #7 (2026-10-03) — backlog_cap bounds the CLOSABLE backlog: findings ARIA's own plan lane could close (finding_grounding.closure_blocker is None) plus findings the runner could not judge. Operator-only findings never count; they are escalated once on governance at operator_escalation_age_days. The closure SLO compares closable findings opened inside closure_slo_window_days with the findings closed inside it. Either pressure throttles a finding opener to one admission per opener_throttle_interval_hours (a rate, never a freeze; event finding_opener_throttled). Bounds: genesis_policy.RHYTHM_BOUNDS; a value outside them is refused by name.

service_expertise._doc: SE-13 (service-expertise PLAN §6.1, §6.5, §6.6, §7.2, §7.3; DECISIONS Q1, Q6, Q13; decision-test PREREG Amendment 4, which PLAN and DECISIONS Q13 call 'Amendment 3' because that number went to the 2026-10-23 case-supply amendment) — the decision values for service knowledge and per-service agents, registered BEFORE the first DEV-check look. genesis_policy.service_expertise_policy parses this block strictly: every key is required, an unknown key or an out-of-range value is refused by its dotted path, and no shipped value stands in for one an override leaves out (merge_with_override replaces the block whole). theta = the share of discordant pairs that favour the measured side; every posterior is calibrated_intelligence.beta_posterior(1 + b, 1 + c).

dev_check._doc: PLAN §7.3, Q6: look_budget DEV-check looks per frozen ARIA SHA for the whole build, every consumer counted: pack_keep_looks for the pack keep decision, section_ablation_looks leave-one-section-out arms, and the remainder (here 3) for genesis EVAL_WINDOW runs. Each look is logged in RUNS.md (SHA, arm, purpose) BEFORE it runs; no second look on one SHA for one decision. Which sections are ablated is fixed by section_ablation_pick before any look: largest_median_tokens_dev_train = the section_ablation_looks sections of change_review.knowledge.sections_in_render_order with the largest median rendered tokens per seat on DEV-train renders (deterministic, spends no DEV-check look; a tie goes to the section later in the render order). The question is which sections earn their tokens, so the costliest are tested; a section not ablated rides on the pack verdict.

final._doc: PREREG Amendment 4 (A3 pin, Q13). A3 = A1 with service_knowledge_mode = a3_service_knowledge_mode and no per-service agent seats (the generic seat serves in their place); same frozen store, routing, contract edges, hand-off and seat caps. A1 carries the per-service agents that reached ACTIVE through the pre-registered DEV-check rule before the freeze (DRAFT/EVAL ones are in neither arm). removed_on_fail lists what a failed final rule removes (Q1); contract edges cannot be listed, they are routing input, not the pack (SK-08).

genesis._doc: PLAN §6.1 and §6.5. A service-keyed REPETITION pressure becomes an agent_gap only if x_S >= k_min, the posterior_quantile (5%) quantile of S's miss-rate posterior exceeds the pooled rate, and a DEV-train re-run after the cheaper D10 rungs still misses >= k_min. EVAL_WINDOW -> ACTIVE in the room: F1.7 paired exact one-sided McNemar at p < alpha (PREREG's own level) and no rise in clean-commit reports; every run is a counted look.

keep._doc: PLAN §7.2, the burden is on the pack. DEV-check pack keep: P(theta > 0.5) >= keep_level_dev AND reports per clean commit (on) <= (off) + clean_report_margin, else the service_knowledge field and the established_knowledge service-root widening are tombstoned for the build. Each ablated section and each per-service slice needs its own P(theta > 0.5) >= keep_level_dev (gain, not absence of harm). Retirement (PLAN §6.6) quarantines an agent whose P(gain > 0) falls below keep_level_dev. Final (Q1, binding, HELD-OUT once, A1 vs A3): P(theta > 0.5) >= keep_level_final AND reports per clean commit A1 <= A3 + clean_report_margin, else final.removed_on_fail. clean_report_margin is an absolute difference in reports per clean commit; 0.0 is PREREG rule 2's own bar ('not higher'). delta_context_recall (SE-4 exit) is an absolute share: context recall WITH contract edges must exceed recall without them by at least 5 points, reported with n and Wilson intervals; it is deterministic (no LLM), measured on DEV-train cases, and spends no DEV-check look.

retirement._doc: PLAN §6.6. On this share of an ACTIVE per-service agent's changes a counterfactual generic seat carrying the same service knowledge runs beside it, inside change_review.seats.seats_per_cycle; over the F0.9 window the paired comparison decides QUARANTINED (keep.keep_level_dev). One in four keeps the extra seats inside the per-cycle envelope while a service changed in most of the 30 window cycles still yields several pairs.

skill_genesis_drainer._doc: Plan ARIA-V7 §2h v2 — V7.4 skill_genesis_drainer per-cycle config. Default enabled (drainer fires every cycle to consume convergent=True requests); operator sets enabled=false to disable drainer entirely.

source_qualification._doc: ARIA-MEDIUM-082 — wall-clock allowance, in seconds, for one bounded scoped-source qualification: the twin self-feature projection at cycle refresh, the per-mint twin re-observation, and pinned evidence-excerpt blob reads. Past the deadline every reader answers qualification_deadline — an honest unknown, never a failure. This was the literal 2 inside snapshot._ScopedSourceBudget, so host load decided what the map answered and neither an operator override nor a test fixture could widen it. 0 is honest (nothing is qualified; every answer is qualification_deadline). Values above 300 are REFUSED with both numbers named so a mint-time qualification stays bounded.

superiority._doc: Z3d + PLAN-v2 F1.7 (ARIA-HIGH-734) — the EVAL_WINDOW -> ACTIVE promotion proof (genesis_superiority), parsed strictly by genesis_policy.superiority_policy: every key required, an unknown or out-of-range key refused by its dotted path, no default fill (an override replaces the block whole). alpha and min_discordant_pairs are the PRE-REGISTERED decision of the paired gain test (agent_eval.compare_eval_windows paired mode): candidate and incumbent on the same case ids, one-sided exact McNemar on the discordant pairs, 'improved' only when p <= alpha AND at least min_discordant_pairs pairs disagree. 0.05 is the decision-test PREREG level (service_expertise.genesis.alpha); 6 is one pair past 5, the smallest count at which p <= 0.05 is reachable at all (5/0 gives 1/32). window_days bounds which eval runs each side reads; min_duel_matches is the decided-duel count below which the Bradley-Terry component is not evaluated and the paired test alone decides.
